title: Glasshouse and Wardrobe
author: Coral Sandoval
blurb: Dominic Okonkwo, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
